svg.title: Olist analytics engineering platform
svg.desc: Six independent data and orchestration lanes preserve EU and US isolation, consent controls and evidence limitations.
svg.text: Six independent lanes. Explicit boundaries. Evidence before claims.
Manual CSV loading • 24 dbt models • reporting, retrospective forecasting and validated AI commentary
Power BI does not feed AI.
Public, obfuscated sample • January 25–31, 2021 • separate report • no EU/US join
Offline by default • consent + explicit opt-in gate vendor tracking • GA4 source reconciliation pending
Vendor branches originate at the storefront; the offline inspector is a parallel local path.
Educational outcomes • hypothetical economics • disconnected fixtures never feed Olist warehouse KPIs
Frankfurter has its own RAW path; Olist metrics have no FX dependency.
FX ingestion → Olist dbt run → dbt tests → AI commentary
Excludes incremental demo. Does not load CSVs, refresh BI, run GA4 or execute forecasting.
Solid arrows: data flow Dashed: opt-in path Raised faces: components, not deployment claims
